name: Opioid Antagonist Standing Order
description: The school physician issues and renews a standing order (antagonist type, date, dosage, signature) authorizing administration of an opioid antagonist.
recipient: District (maintained by Director of Student Services)
quote: The school physician shall provide and annually renew a standing order for administration of an opioid antagonist to students, staff members or other individuals believed or suspected to be experiencing an opioid overdose.
